text: Cooking is the process of transforming raw ingredients into delectable food through heat and the application of various techniques and ingredients. Among the essential culinary staples are garlic and onions, which are used extensively in numerous dishes to add depth of flavor. Garlic is a pungent bulbous vegetable that, when minced or grated, releases a potent, aromatic liquid that enhances the taste of a wide array of foods. Its distinct flavor complements other ingredients, whether it’s a simple sauce or a complex curry, contributing to a harmonious and delicious final product. Aspiring cooks should experiment with these versatile vegetables, starting with minced garlic, to discover their full potential in every dish.
